Senses.Explanation: A verb phrase: “awaken” plus “the Way.” Chan records use it retrospectively in biographies and cases: Lingyun awakens on seeing peach blossoms, the Buddha on seeing the morning star, and other monks after an encounter or event; verses composed afterward are called “verses on awakening to the Way.” The stock pairing “awaken to the Way on hearing a sound; clarify mind on seeing a form” is itself raised and questioned in a hall address. The records also police the designation: one text calls memorizing two convenient sayings and naming that “awakening to the Way” one of the enumerated kinds of foolish Chan. Thus the term names an attested event and biographical verdict, while the corpus also records challenges to loose claims of it.
Senses.Note: The compound “verse on awakening to the Way” retains the same event sense and is not a separate referent for “awaken to the Way” itself.

Occurrences.Kwic: 舉古云聞聲悟道見色明心師云作麼生是聞聲悟道見色明心
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, Yunmen Wenyan's Essential Sayings from the Master's Room. Yunmen Wenyan is the exact speaker: after raising the old wording 'awaken to the Way on hearing sound; clarify mind on seeing form,' he directly asks what that wording means.

Occurrences.Kwic: 古人見桃華悟道，子作麼生？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 嘉泰普燈錄, Jiuxian Qifu biography. Huanglong Huinan is the exact questioner who asks Jiuxian what he makes of the ancient who awakened to the Way on seeing peach blossoms.

Occurrences.Kwic: 忽然大悟乃有悟道頌云我有明珠一顆久被諸塵封褁
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, Foyan Qingyuan's general address. Foyan Qingyuan is the exact narrating speaker: he recounts Chaling Yu's fall from a donkey, says Chaling suddenly awakened greatly, and introduces the ensuing verse as his verse on awakening to the Way.

Occurrences.Kwic: 或有向古人方便語中記得兩句，謂之悟道，謂之通宗
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Zhanran Yuancheng (湛然圓澄禪師語錄). Zhanran Yuancheng is the exact speaker of the continuous admonition: he criticizes people who memorize two phrases from the ancients' expedient sayings and call that awakening to the Way or penetrating the lineage.

Occurrences.Kwic: 十二月八日明星現時，豁然悟道，大地有情，一時成佛
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 嘉泰普燈錄, Yun'an Kewen section. The Buddha is the exact actor in Yun'an's narrated awakening scene: when the morning star appeared on the eighth day of the twelfth month, Shakyamuni suddenly awakened to the Way.
